name: find-ideas-v01
title: dsh-find-ideas v0.1: prior-art search + skeleton extraction
description: Ship dsh-find-ideas as a DSH host plugin that reuses the proven deterministic core of dsh-idea-scout (three-query long-tail pool, code-computed ranking, degradation contract) and adds the four capabilities idea-scout lacks: in-plugin LLM translation of non-English ideas, Markdown table output, a pushed_at (last-updated) column, and class/function signature skeleton extraction for user-selected repos.
creator: Tianyao2003
